sections.name: body
sections.value: PR314 final round at ed67200 closes both R1 findings. Expiry ends the original hold and tests delivered/sibling eligibility in one transaction; pending, running or held-unexpired copies suppress a notice only for the same kind/origin/key. Kind embeds recipient. Another recipient or origin does not suppress expiry. A running sibling that fails terminally permits the later notice, without recovering the expired original. Recovery now scopes live copies by kind as well. Original real-service witnesses and closure tests passed: five daemon and three store cases. Independent exact-SQL M8/M9 controls were killed and the author retained isolated Rust logs; do not conflate those evidence grades. Reconciled preaccepted rows are preserved; the 64 brake applies only to new sends. Existing negative-expiry sweep cost is D-F260-4. MagicWand achieved: the R1 failure oracles are committed regressions with retained mutation receipts.
